title: Shift Change
event: Overhead rails ratchet; a fleet of motorized shelving banks silently rotate and recline, floor panels slide and lock so the main atrium's straight aisles rearrange into a single spiralling corridor. Angle-mounted lamps reorient into narrow pools that trace the new curve. A maintenance trolley, jammed between two rotated racks, drops a small metal tag onto white tile.
consequence: the floor now shows a newly formed curved pathway and a lone metal maintenance tag lying on the tile.
nextHook: Betriebsform carried forward as the operating arrangement that reorganized the aisles.

cameraCue: After the reconfiguration, the camera pushes forward along the new curved aisle and lingers on the maintenance tag, revealing the changed circulation.

title: Cold Display
event: Refrigerated display cases that line the spiral fill, each tray populated by uniformly cut slabs of raw meat. Under the new Betriebsform they subtly realign in parallel rows—each slab shudders in a coordinated, millimetric twitch that sends faint rivulets of condensation along the inner glass before settling.
consequence: a thermometer slips from a ledge and smashes, leaving a small jagged smear of red on the white floor tile.
nextHook: Althochdeutsche Sprache (Fleisch) becomes the dominant object behavior, intensifying the reconfiguration.

cameraCue: After the tiny tremors in the cases, the camera dollies inward to the fallen thermometer and the red smear on the tile, revealing the consequence.

title: Label Pulse
event: Fluorescent strips along the ceiling begin to pulse in short hazardous cadences; printed hazard-like shapes appear as frost on the inside of the display glass and rearrange into repeating patterns. From behind a column, a weathered practical sculpture—patinated, composite-material, mechanically rigged—slides into view, damp with glass condensation. It moves with puppet-like micro-adjustments and presses a hand to a case; the pressure causes a tray of meat to spiral and a corner pane to crack.
consequence: a cracked display case with a jagged opening where meat has spilled slightly inward.
nextHook: H- und P-Sätze intensifies the facility's signs and behaviors, now physically fracturing an object.

cameraCue: After the crack appears, handheld camera pushes in tight on the jagged opening to frame the damaged interior of the case and the damp texture of the sculpture's hand.

title: Evacuation Choreography
event: A small cluster of shoppers enters the reorganized spiral, responding to the rhythmic light pulses and the cracked case. Their movements adopt synchronized safety gestures—pointing, stepping back, hands raised in repeated, rehearsed motions—like a bounced echo of the H- und P-Sätze cadence. One child drops a small plastic coin-shaped toy that bounces and skids to rest near the cracked case; the group hurries past without looking back.
consequence: a trail of quick wet footprints leading from the crowd toward the cracked display case and the dropped plastic coin beside the opening.
nextHook: Public behavior amplifies the hazard rhythm into choreographed evacuation gestures.
stillPrompt: Still of shoppers in the Kaufhaus mid-gesture: a small group performing synchronized safety motions in the spiral aisle, blurred faces, a plastic coin near the cracked display case on the tile. No monster, no text.

cameraCue: After the group passes, the camera tilts down to follow the wet footprints leading toward the cracked case, concealing whatever lies beyond the break.

title: Smoke and Barricade
event: Alarms stutter; a low wall of theatrical smoke blooms from a floor vent in the atrium. Shoppers bolt in panic and scatter into the spiral aisles. In the smoke, the same weathered practical sculpture steps forward with deliberate, heavy measured motions—its surface catching the light—and pushes a collapsed shelving bay across the spiral to form a crude barricade. The movement sends scattered shopping bags tumbling and scuffs a dark, singed patch into the tile where a lamp fell.
consequence: a collapsed shelving barricade across the spiral, strewn shopping bags, and a scorched patch on the floor.
nextHook: Terrorism disrupts circulation and converts structure into obstruction, leaving visible wreckage.

title: Retail Aftermath
event: Smoke thins; shoppers begin to sift through the barricade's debris, picking up and inspecting discarded items as if evaluating value. A woman lifts a white paper bag from the scattered pile—on its side a damp handprint in patinated residue is visible. Instead of fleeing, a small group folds the barricade into a makeshift display and exchange begins: a tidal, pragmatic reallocation of goods.
consequence: someone leaves the Kaufhaus carrying a white paper bag marked by a damp weathered handprint, turning wreckage into a carried commodity.
nextHook: Konsum resolves the visible residue by converting the barricade and scattered objects into objects of exchange.
